date_note: The page, published 27 November, gives the SAP statement as made that Friday and no earlier day.
exec: Portal do Zacarias reports SAP said it identified suspicious activity in its digital environment and started emergency measures; SAP found no evidence of unauthorised access to customer business data.
geo_basis: headquarters: SAP is based in Walldorf, Germany; the page names no site of the activity
plain: Portal do Zacarias reports SAP said it found suspicious activity in its digital environment and began emergency measures. SAP did not reveal the origin, those responsible or the scope.

sources.name: Portal do Zacarias: SAP confirms cyberattack and triggers emergency measures (Portuguese)

summary: Portal do Zacarias reports that SAP said in a statement it identified suspicious activity in its digital environment and started emergency measures to protect its systems and customers. The page says SAP found no evidence of unauthorised access to customer business data and did not reveal the origin of the activity or the scope. It adds that German press reports described a possible intrusion into development infrastructure on GitHub, which SAP did not confirm on this page.
title: SAP says it identified suspicious activity and started emergency measures, Portal do Zacarias reports

validation.note: One publisher (Portal do Zacarias, Portuguese) relaying an SAP statement; SAP's own page and the German press reports it cites were not read; independent searches found no second report.
